text:
incident-bot: P0 alert — TID-983 (TidalWave, enterprise). 5xx gateway spike in eu-west-1; error rate 18% over the last 5m, user-facing latency up. Pager routed to oncall. Incident channel: #incident-tid-983

alex-oncall: Acknowledged. I’m on it. Starting triage and creating a short incident rundown for customer comms.

mike-eng: Looking at ingress logs — upstream 502s correlated with a deployment at 03:02 UTC and a flurry of connection resets. Suspect a rollout issue + backend pod drain backlog.

raj-sre: Noted. I’ll pause the rollout and scale up the healthy backend ASG by +30% to reduce queueing. Also enabling circuit-breaker on gateway.

alex-oncall: Action items:
- mike: roll back candidate release or pin to previous model (if safe)
- raj: scale up + enable CB
- sara: prep customer-facing notice, target TidalWave contacts first
- jess: prepare status page blurb + ps template for enterprise customers

sara-cs: TidalWave contact list (primary routing):
- TidalWave Support (support@tidalwave.co)
- Engineering lead: liam.chen@tidalwave.co (tw-engr)
- CSM: natalie@tidalwave.co
We should send targeted email + status page. No broad broadcast until we confirm impact window.

jess-pm: Draft status page blurb (short):
"service degraded: We are investigating elevated error rates affecting TidalWave customer requests in eu-west-1. Engineers are mitigating the issue; updates every 15 minutes."

jess-pm: Draft targeted email to TidalWave (please review):
"Hi Liam / Natalie — We’re currently investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting your account (TID-983) in eu-west-1. Our engineers have paused a recent rollout and are scaling backend capacity to reduce errors. We’ll follow up with an ETA in 15 minutes and provide ongoing updates. If you need immediate help or have specific transactions to prioritize, reply to this thread and we will escalate. — Redwood Inference Incident Response"

mike-eng: Quick mitigation plan:
1) rollback release to v2.14.1 (candidate released at 03:02)
2) scale backend pool to +30% for 10m
3) enable gateway CB and prefix caching to reduce load
4) monitor error rate and latency; if >10% after 10m, open full failover to alternate region

alex-oncall: Rolling rollback now. mike, ping here when rollback completes. raj, confirm scaling started.

raj-sre: Scale up started — provisioning 6 instances. Circuit-breaker enabled at gateway.

ops-bot: rollback job triggered: deploy.rollback --service gateway --to v2.14.1 --by alex-oncall (job id: rb-4123)

mike-eng: Rollback initiated; backend health checks show gradual return. Monitoring tailing logs.

incident-bot: Automated update — error rate down to 7% after rollback and scale-up (5m window). Still above baseline; continue monitoring.

alex-oncall: Good progress. Sending preliminary targeted notification to TidalWave (sara please send). Sara, paste the final email into thread before sending so we have audit copy.

sara-cs: Sending now. Email sent to support@tidalwave.co and natalie@tidalwave.co with incident summary and next steps. Copy of sent message:
"Subject: Incident: Elevated 5xx errors affecting TidalWave (TID-983) — Ongoing
Hi Liam / Natalie,
We’re investigating elevated 5xx responses in eu-west-1 impacting your account. Actions taken: paused recent rollout, rolled back gateway to v2.14.1, scaled backend +30%, enabled gateway circuit-breaker. Current status: error rate reduced to ~7% and trending down. Next update in 15 minutes.
If you have critical traffic, please reply with transaction IDs and we’ll prioritize.
— Redwood Inference IR"

jess-pm: Status page update posted (small blurb) — monitoring. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4123456789

mike-eng: Observability: CPU on affected pods back to normal, 95th latency improving. Still seeing intermittent 502s with one backend shard — investigating database connection pool exhaustion.

raj-sre: Temporary mitigation: we increased DB pool size on that shard and turned on connection queueing metrics. If we see DB errors persist, we’ll route traffic away from that shard.

alex-oncall: Internal comms template for CS/Sales (copy for records):
"Short summary: Customers on eu-west-1 experienced elevated 5xx errors due to a recent gateway rollout and downstream DB connection pressure. Mitigation: rolled back gateway to v2.14.1, scaled backend, adjusted DB pool. Impacted customers: TidalWave (TID-983) — targeted notification sent.
Action owners: alex-oncall (incident lead), mike-eng (eng), raj-sre (infra), sara-cs (customer comms), jess-pm (status page).
Next steps: monitor for 30 minutes, verify replayed traffic success, post incident postmortem.
"

sara-cs: CS note: prepping customer-facing postmortem template; will attach impact timeline and remediation steps once incident resolves.

incident-bot: Update scheduled in 15 minutes. If no regression, we will downgrade severity to P1 and escalate to postmortem.

alex-oncall: Thanks team. Keep updates short here. If error rate drops below 1% for 20m, we close and start RCA.

mike-eng: Observability shows stable drop to 1.2% over last 8 minutes, tailing. Continuing to watch.

raj-sre: DB shard metrics normalized after pool increase. No further action required for now.

jess-pm: Draft customer post-incident blurb (to include in follow-up email):
"What happened: a gateway rollout triggered an incompatibility causing connection resets and backend queueing, resulting in elevated 5xx responses for a subset of customer traffic in eu-west-1.
What we did: paused rollout, rolled back to previous gateway version, scaled backend capacity, increased DB pool for affected shard, enabled circuit-breaker.
Status: service restored, monitoring in progress.
We will follow up with an RCA and timeline within 72 hours"

alex-oncall: Closing checklist: confirm rollback stable, verify customer email delivered, post status page final update. If all good, I'll mark incident resolved and handoff to raj/mike for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident update: error rate steady at ~1.0% over 12m. Recommended: downgrade to P1.

alex-oncall: Downgrading to P1. Preparing to resolve — will post resolution note in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark: 

sara-cs: TidalWave acknowledged receipt and thanked us for quick response. They requested transaction-level logs for Jan 12 03:00–03:15 UTC; sara will coordinate secure upload.

mike-eng: Copy — will prepare requested logs and mark any anomaly lines.

alex-oncall: Great work everyone. Finalize the incident ticket and assign RCA owners.

ops-bot: Incident channel #incident-tid-983 archived by alex-oncall (timebox: incident resolved).
